q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
(a) **Time left until resolution:**
Today is 2026-08-13. Q2 FY2027 would end in late August/early September 2026. NVIDIA's earnings release for Q2 FY2027 would typically occur 3-4 weeks after quarter-end, likely in early-to-mid September 2026. This means resolution is approximately 3-4 weeks away.

(b) **Most likely outcome and why:**
The CURRENT RESEARCH provides the actual forward guidance that NVIDIA has already issued: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of **$89.18 billion to $92.82 billion**.

This is not a prediction—this is NVIDIA's official guidance already announced on May 20, 2026. The question asks what NVIDIA's forward guidance will be in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release. Companies rarely materially change their guidance between announcement and the actual earnings report unless there has been a dramatic unexpected development.

The guidance of $91.0B ± 2% falls solidly within the provided range (99.5B to 115.5B is the full range, but the actual guidance is significantly lower).

(c) **What would push the value lower?**
- A dramatic deterioration in enterprise/AI spending between May and August 2026
- Unexpected geopolitical or regulatory developments affecting NVIDIA's addressable market
- Major customer deferrals or cancellations
- However, such a significant negative revision would be highly unusual so close to quarter-end with actual results almost certain

(d) **What would push the value higher?**
- Unexpected strength in demand causing NVIDIA to raise guidance
- This is more plausible than a downward revision at this stage
- However, raising guidance 3-4 weeks before quarter-end would suggest they didn't anticipate this strength initially, which is possible but less common
- Any raise would likely be modest (perhaps to $92-93B range) rather than dramatic

(e) **Base rate or historical reference values:**
No reliable base rate available from the provided materials. However, the CURRENT RESEARCH explicitly states that NVIDIA announced $91.0 billion ± 2% for Q2 FY2027 guidance. This is not a forecast but actual announced company guidance.

**Reasoning:**
Given that NVIDIA has already publicly issued guidance of $91.0B ± 2%, the question of what their guidance will be in the earnings release is largely determined. Companies maintain their guidance unless circumstances fundamentally change. The most likely scenario is that this guidance remains in place.

The central estimate should be **$91.0 billion**, with the typical ±2% band representing management's stated uncertainty range. There's a small probability of a modest revision upward (if business has been stronger than expected), and an even smaller probability of a downward revision (which would signal problems).

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has provided strong forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (Q2 FY2027). On May 20, 2026, the company announced an expected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This figure is significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

NVIDIA also specified that its outlook for Q2 FY2027 does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027). Additionally, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are projected to be approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).
